objective: Agent correctly searches existing test patterns via semantic_search with chunkType 'test' / 'test_setup' + rerank='proven' + level='chunk' (testFile='only' only as disclosed file-level fallback) BEFORE writing a failing test, extracts conventions as a pattern block, and hands off to superpowers:test-driven-development.

mustCall: Step 2 pattern search FIRST: semantic_search split queries: chunkType 'test_setup' (fixtures, Step 2a) and chunkType 'test' (assertion idioms, Step 2b), each + rerank 'proven' + level 'chunk' + metaOnly false, optional pathPattern scoping chunker tests; testFile 'only' ONLY as the disclosed file-level fallback when the tests-as-context preflight finds no DSL test chunks
